profiles.title: Direct3D 10 / 11 graphics
profiles.summary: Install the pinned DXVK macOS component in this bottle.
limitations: Requires a compatible external Wine runtime and MoltenVK. Direct3D 9 and 12 are not provided.

profiles.title: Simplified Chinese text
profiles.summary: Install Noto Sans CJK SC and use the Simplified Chinese locale in this bottle.
limitations: Fonts and locale settings do not translate an application's own text.

profiles.title: R2Beat downloader
profiles.summary: Prepare graphics and Chinese text for the verified publisher downloader.
limitations: Downloader compatibility does not establish game compatibility.
The game launcher's Mono / .NET crash and anti-cheat compatibility are not fixed by this setup.
